cases.name: test-apply-file-redirection-normal-output
cases.description: Verifies that standard output can be saved to a file target correctly.
cases.expected_behavior: Command output is successfully written into the designated target file instead of the console.

cases.name: test-apply-file-redirection-normal-input
cases.description: Verifies that standard input can be loaded from a file target correctly.
cases.expected_behavior: Command reads its standard input from the specified source file instead of the terminal.

cases.name: test-apply-file-redirection-edge-invalid-file
cases.description: Verifies correct handling of non-existent files during stream redirection setup.
cases.expected_behavior: The shell catches the file access error, reports an appropriate message, and avoids crashing.

cases.name: test-apply-file-redirection-oracle-dynamic
cases.description: Performs dynamic validation of stream redirection under varied runtime inputs.
cases.expected_behavior: Ensures streams are correctly configured across diverse file names and operational conditions.
